why_become_partner.title: Why Become a BEAPOne Channel Partner?
why_become_partner.subtitle: Real benefits for technology partners, consultants, and business advisors

items.title: Recurring Revenue Model
items.text: Earn 15–25% commission on every active subscription you provision. Your clients pay monthly, you get paid monthly. Build predictable, growing revenue.

items.title: Instant Provisioning
items.text: Create new BEAPOne Lite accounts for your clients in seconds. No manual paperwork, no waiting days for approval. Click "Provision" and they're live immediately.

items.title: Real-Time Performance Dashboard
items.text: Track every client's usage, revenue contribution, and activity in real-time. See exactly which accounts are growing and which need attention.

items.title: White-Label Ready

items.title: Multi-Country Support
items.text: Provision clients across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, and more. BEAPOne supports local currencies, tax rules, and business regulations.

items.title: Expand Your Service Offering

how_it_works.title: How Channel Management Works
how_it_works.subtitle: From signing up as a partner to earning your first commission in 3 simple steps

steps.title: Provision New Lite Users (Flow 1: A2-7 → Lite)
steps.text: When you find a client who needs business management software, log into this Channel Portal and click "Provision New User". Enter their email and basic info. The system instantly creates a BEAPOne Lite account linked to your Partner ID.
steps.example: Tunde in Lagos needs accounting software → You enter tunde@company.ng → Click Provision → Lite instance created in 3 seconds → Tunde receives login credentials → He's up and running in 5 minutes!

steps.title: Automatic Usage Tracking (Flow 2: Lite → A2-4)
steps.text: Every hour, each Lite instance automatically reports usage metrics to our central billing system: active users, transactions processed, storage used. You don't do anything—it's completely automatic. This data calculates your revenue share.
steps.behind_the_scenes: Tunde's Lite instance sends: "12 active users, 487 transactions, 24GB storage" → A2-4 calculates: $149/month subscription → You earn 25% = $37.25/month for that one client.

steps.title: Real-Time Dashboard & Revenue (Flow 3: A2-7 ← Lite)
steps.text: This dashboard fetches aggregated performance data from all your provisioned Lite instances. See total active users, revenue trends, and which clients are growing. Your commission is automatically calculated monthly and paid via your preferred method.
steps.dashboard_example: Your dashboard shows: 10 active clients → Total revenue: $1,490/month → Your commission (25%): $372.50/month → Paid on the 5th of each month to your bank account.

real_story.title: Real Story: How TechBridge Africa Built $45K/Year Recurring Revenue
real_story.partner: TechBridge Africa is an IT consulting firm in Lagos serving 200+ SME clients. They were already helping clients with technology but had no recurring revenue—only one-time project fees.
real_story.strategy: They became a BEAPOne Gold Partner (25% commission rate) and started offering BEAPOne Lite as an add-on service. "We install it for you, train your staff, and provide local support." Their value-add was implementation and training—BEAPOne handled the software.
real_story.results: In 12 months, they provisioned 150 Lite users across their client base. Average subscription: $120/month. Total client revenue: $18,000/month. TechBridge commission (25%): $4,500/month = $54,000/year. Predictable, recurring income that grows every quarter.
real_story.quote: "We're not software developers, but now we earn like we built the product ourselves. Best business decision we made." - Chidi, TechBridge CEO
